Class AsyncJobService

public without sharing class AsyncJobService

Service class for managing asynchronous job operations. Provides utilities for checking if jobs are already scheduled, retrieving pending job information, and safely enqueueing Queueable jobs with duplicate prevention and error handling.

Methods

public static Id enqueueJob(
  Queueable queueableInstance,
  String className,
  AsyncOptions options
)

Enqueues a Queueable job with duplicate prevention. Only enqueues the job if it is not already scheduled or if the className is blank. Logs any exceptions that occur during enqueueing.

Parameters:
    queueableInstance – The Queueable class instance to enqueue
    className – The name of the Queueable class for duplicate checking
    options – The AsyncOptions configuration for the job (delay, duplicate signature, etc.)

Returns:
    Id The Id of the enqueued job, or null if not enqueued or if an error occurred

public static AsyncJobService.ScheduledJobInfo getPendingJobInfo(String jobName)

Returns information about a pending scheduled job by its name. Queries CronTrigger records to find jobs in a pending state.

Parameters:
    jobName – The name of the scheduled job to check

Returns:
    ScheduledJobInfo The job information if found, null otherwise

public static Boolean isClassScheduled(String className)

Checks if a class is already scheduled or queued for execution by querying AsyncApexJob records. Useful for preventing duplicate job submissions.

Parameters:
    className – The fully qualified name of the class to check

Returns:
    Boolean True if the class has pending jobs, false otherwise
